h1: Local Carpenter: Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds & Cambridge

intro.html: Choosing a local carpenter isn’t just about finding someone who can cut and fix timber. It’s about working with a skilled craftsman who listens to what you need, understands the quirks of your home, and creates solutions that genuinely improve your everyday life. At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we’ve built a reputation across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and the surrounding region for delivering bespoke carpenter services that are practical, creative, and built to last.

Since 2013, our family-run business has combined over 40 years of carpentry and construction experience with a simple promise: to treat every project, large or small, with the same care and attention to detail. From one-off storage solutions to full kitchen fittings, we offer a personal, down-to-earth service that larger firms often struggle to match.

chapters.heading: Local Carpenter Craftsmanship with a Personal Touch

blocks.html: As your trusted local carpenter, we specialise in the finer details that make a house a home. This might be a fitted bookshelf for a living room alcove, a wardrobe that makes the best use of an awkward corner, or a bespoke piece of furniture that reflects your style. We take time to understand how you use your space, then design and build something that works perfectly for you.

Homes in Cambridgeshire and Suffolk come in all shapes and sizes, which is why off-the-shelf storage often doesn’t cut it. Our local carpenter services include fitted furniture and storage that’s made to measure. From under-stair cupboards to alcove shelving, we’ll help you reclaim space while adding a touch of character to your home.

blocks.html: We design and build bespoke cabinetry that’s as stylish as it is practical. Whether you want a built-in bookcase, a fitted wardrobe, or a unique piece of cabinetry for a kitchen or lounge, our joinery is tailored to your taste. Every project is carefully hand-finished, so you can expect the same high standard of craftsmanship throughout.

chapters.heading: Media Walls & Feature Joinery from a Local Carpenter

blocks.html: Our bespoke media walls are a modern way to combine storage and technology. By incorporating shelving, cabinets, and hidden cable management, we turn your TV wall into a neat, clutter-free focal point. Each media wall is designed around your equipment, your layout, and your lifestyle: no two are the same.

While we’re best known for bespoke joinery, our local bespoke carpenter services also cover kitchen fitting and small-scale home improvements. From installing new kitchen doors and worktops to crafting bespoke islands or storage units, we can refresh and upgrade your space without the disruption of a full renovation. And because we’re part of a multi-skilled team with access to trusted bricklayers, plasterers and other trades, we can also help with those finishing touches that bring everything together.

chapters.heading: Why Homeowners Choose Us as Their Local Carpenter

blocks.html: Homeowners across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and surrounding areas trust us because we combine expertise with approachability. Our NVQ-qualified team offers traditional carpentry skills backed by modern construction know-how, ensuring every project is delivered to a high standard. We provide a one-year workmanship guarantee and hold full public liability insurance, giving you extra peace of mind. Most importantly, we’re friendly, reliable, and passionate about getting the details right.
